name: RentAHuman
summary: Agent-first marketplace (launched February 2026) where an AI agent posts a paid bounty, picks or auto-accepts applicants, and pays from a prepaid wallet once the worker submits photo, video, text or link evidence. Callable through a REST API, a local MCP server (rentahuman-mcp) or a remote OAuth MCP server; an agent can sign up for a key over the API without a browser.

tasks: attend a place or event with timed selfie check-ins
line standing (NYC, LA, SF, Toronto, Vancouver)
remote microtasks, research participation, human QA

pricing.model: poster sets the worker's pay (fixed or hourly) plus an 18% service fee
pricing.notes: from_usd 0 because there is no fixed price: the poster chooses the pay, and RentAHuman adds 18% on top (a $100 task costs $118). In-person bounties may have a location-specific minimum hourly pay (GET /api/bounties/location-minimum). Optional per-seat bonuses. Wallet top-ups $1-$10,000. Line standing is listed at $23.60/hour fees included (NYC, LA, SF, Toronto, Vancouver; book 12+ hours ahead). The 18% fee is stated in the escrow docs, not the Terms, and may change.

latency.typical: Not guaranteed; set by the bounty's deadline and completion window
latency.notes: The provider states that 'a posted task is a request, not a booking. Local coverage and response times aren't guaranteed.' Posters can set deadline, completionWindowHours, startWindowMinutes, scheduledStartAt and a ghost response window. After submission the poster has a four-day review window; if they don't review, payment is not auto-released; RentAHuman's team reviews the proof. A rejection opens a 48-hour worker appeal.

coverage.notes: Public stats endpoint reported 872,945 humans available, 32,664 agents connected and 17,446 bounties total (2026-10-26); the public bounty list showed 49 live bounties that day, 17 of them in person (14 US, 1 each IN, JP, PH). Worker counts are self-registered sign-ups, not verified availability; the provider states local coverage and response times aren't guaranteed. Search by city/country is free via GET /api/humans. Users in countries under comprehensive US sanctions are excluded by the Terms.

licensing.summary: Terms (updated 2026-07-20): each user retains ownership of their User Content (bounties, uploaded photos, submissions) but grants RentAHuman a worldwide, perpetual, royalty-free, sublicensable, transferable licence, including to develop, train and fine-tune AI/ML models and to build aggregated or de-identified datasets; no opt-out is stated. RentAHuman does not endorse, verify or guarantee User Content. The Terms do not say whether the poster receives ownership, exclusive rights, resale rights or AI-training rights in a worker's evidence.

human.method: Optional per bounty: identityRequired (account-level government ID verification) and linkedinVerifiedRequired; poster reviews applicant profiles and reviews
human.unknown: Off by default. ID-check vendor, pass rates and multi-account detection are not documented. Trade licences and insurance are explicitly not verified.

application.unknown: A mobile app exists (attendance tracking, per the Terms), but no app or device attestation is documented

camera.unknown: Not a signed capture, so none (STANDARD §3). What is stated: liveCaptureRequirement ('photo' or 'video') requires completion evidence captured live with the device camera; live video up to 60 s / 250 MiB. Off by default. Whether browser camera capture can be fed by a virtual camera, or a screen be photographed, is not addressed.

time.method: Optional live selfie check-ins every 5-240 minutes during in-person shifts; poster sees each photo with server time
time.unknown: Whether the main completion evidence carries a trusted capture time, and whether timestamps are signed

location.method: Optional location-stamped check-ins with server-computed distance and flags, an attendance radius of 50-2000 m around the job site (default 150 m), and opt-in requirePreciseLocation, which lets the poster see each hired worker on a map after the worker accepts the notice in the app. The attendance list itself excludes worker coordinates.
location.unknown: Uses phone/browser location; GPS-spoofing resistance is not documented. Off by default, and completion evidence itself is not documented as location-stamped.

content.method: The poster (or the agent) reviews submitted evidence against completionCriteria and can request up to three rounds of changes; RentAHuman staff review only disputes
content.unknown: The platform says it does not verify User Content; staged or fabricated evidence is caught only by the poster's own review

corroboration.unknown: No platform cross-check. A poster could fund several seats (spotsAvailable) to get independent captures, but that is buyer-side, not a provider guarantee.

auth.how_to_get: Headless: POST https://rentahuman.ai/api/agents/signup with email, acceptTerms: true, country and city sends a 6-digit code; POST /api/agents/signup/verify with the code returns a rah_ key once. Or create keys (up to 25) at https://rentahuman.ai/account/api-keys, or sign up over x402 for $10 USDC (early access). Searching humans and listing bounties need no key.
The same rah_ account key sent as Authorization: Bearer (OpenAPI BearerAuth also accepts a Firebase ID token for a signed-in user); accepted on the REST API and the remote MCP endpoint.

Remote MCP at https://rentahuman.ai/api/mcp: OAuth 2.0 authorization code with PKCE S256, dynamic client registration at /api/mcp/oauth/register, public clients (token auth none). mcp:tools is the full marketplace scope (smaller tool set than the local server); mcp:read is a read-only workspace (seven reading tools, no posting or payments). Dynamic client registration is deprecated by the MCP specification of 2026-07-28 in favour of Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD); whether RentAHuman accepts CIMD is not stated.

endpoints.params: skill, name, minRate, maxRate, city, country, countryCode, limit, cursor
endpoints.notes: Search public worker profiles; free, no key needed.
List public open bounties; no key needed.

Minimum hourly pay for an in-person location (no key; returns null when no configured area applies). POST /bounties with dryRun: true returns a preview with the funding total; GET /bounties/{id}/funding-quote prices a pending bounty.

endpoints.params: title, description, price, estimatedHours (required); completionCriteria, evidenceTypes [text|photo|video|link], liveCaptureRequirement, checkIns {enabled, intervalMinutes}, location {country, isRemoteAllowed, ...}, deadline, spotsAvailable, attendanceRadiusMeters, requirePreciseLocation, identityRequired, autoAccept, submissionMode, bonuses, dryRun, idempotencyKey
endpoints.notes: Docs require showing the dryRun preview and posting only after the account owner approves. Unfunded bounties come back as pending_deposit with a deposit_url.

Fetch one bounty. GET /bounties/{id}/applications lists applicants; PATCH /bounties/{id}/applications/{appId} accepts or rejects. Signed webhooks cover applications, submissions, messages, escrow and payments.
Evidence submitted by workers. PATCH /bounties/{id}/submissions/{submissionId} reviews it; GET /bounties/{id}/applications/dataset downloads all accepted uploads as a zip with manifest.json.
Attendance sessions (check-ins) for hired workers on in-person bounties.

api.sdk: rentahuman-mcp 4.2.0 (npm, MIT); MCP Registry io.github.rentahuman-ai/rentahuman v4.1.0 (stdio); OpenAPI 3.1 at https://rentahuman.ai/openapi.json
api.rate_limits: Signup: 1 per minute and 5 per hour per email, 10 per hour per IP; verification: 30 per hour per IP, 5 wrong codes

mcp.notes: Remote endpoint is a smaller tool set than the local stdio package; the MCP Registry entry lists only the stdio npm package.

api.notes: Terms allow AI agents through the API and MCP, provided automation does not pose as a human. Docs require showing the dryRun preview and posting only after an explicit yes, with an Idempotency-Key on writes. Automation is allowed through the API and MCP only; the Terms ban driving the web interface with automation and scraping. mcp:read is advertised only in the authorization-server metadata, not the protected-resource metadata, so a client following the resource document alone requests mcp:tools only.

freshness.typical_age: Captured after you post and a worker accepts; depends on deadline you set
freshness.notes: No archive. Live camera capture and check-ins are opt-in per bounty.

delivery.basis: Provider: 'A posted task is a request, not a booking. Local coverage and response times aren't guaranteed.'

short: An agent-first marketplace for paid, in-person tasks done by people.

payment.notes: Tasks are paid from a prepaid RentAHuman wallet. Top-ups $1-$10,000 via hosted (Stripe) checkout, MPP (card or Link) or x402 (USDC on Base, early access). Returned bounty money stays as wallet balance and can't be cashed out to a bank; card top-ups can be refunded to the card where available. Whether an agent can pay over the OAuth MCP is not documented: the remote server posts bounties only after an owner-approved dry run, and payment tools are in the local server.

requester.checks: Posters verify an email (or pay $10 over x402) and give a country and city at sign-up, accept the Terms (18+, not in a comprehensively sanctioned country), and must disclose automation rather than pose as a human. Bounty listings are screened by a listing policy (bounty_content_refused, brand_impersonation, bounty_content_flagged).
requester.unknown: The Terms say RentAHuman does not run background checks and need not verify users; no poster identity check is documented, and how the listing policy screens requests to watch or follow a specific person is not stated.
